create_scannet_dataset_config: create a ScannetDatasetConfig instance to map 18 ScanNet object classes to NYU40 IDs and class indices
rotate_aligned_boxes: rotate axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes by a given rotation matrix using ScannetDatasetConfig.rotate_aligned_boxes
convert_box_param_to_corners: convert box center, size, and angle parameters to 3D corner coordinates using box_parametrization_to_corners_np
create_scannet_detection_dataset: create a ScannetDetectionDataset for training 3D object detection with configurable point count, augmentation, and random cuboid sampling
load_scannet_scan_item: load a ScanNet scan by index via ScannetDetectionDataset getitem to get point clouds, bounding boxes, and semantic labels
